newsitem.title: GERMANY: Zeneca bid talk is speculation - Bayer.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca bid talk is speculation - Bayer.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Bayer AG on Thursday said market talk it may launch a bid for U.K. drugs group Zeneca Group plc was "pure speculation", adding there were no concrete plans for a merger.

"What is happening here is pure speculation," Bayer spokesman Thomas Reinert said in answer to Reuter enquiries whether the German drugs giant was exploring the possibility of an alliance with the U.K. group.

Reinert added, "Bayer conducts regular talks with all major players in the industry about a number of topics but there is nothing to the talk that discussions have progressed to any sort of concrete phase."

Speculation about a bid for Zeneca sent shares to a year high of 16.30 sterling while Bayer shares, one of the most actively traded issues in Frankfurt today, closed floor trading up 39 pfennigs at 55.43 marks.

Industry analysts have in the past named Zeneca as a possible merger candidate for Bayer, saying an alliance between the two could become a more serious option especially as Bayer itself said it may consider spinning off its drugs division into a separate legal entity and find a junior partner
